## Summary

Adopt the shared Rolling Release v2 caller. Keep the producer that prepared the initial v0.1.0 proposal in the replay history so the new writer can verify the existing tag.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Apply Rolling Release v2 to future releases while preserving exact verification of the existing release history.
impact: Build, maintenance, workflow, and refactor changes can start patch releases.
required_action: null
```

## Evidence

- The v1 workflow published v0.1.0 at the exact approved squash landing. [Release proposal #16](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lint-gate/pull/16)
- The staged v2 caller passed Actionlint. The v0.8.0 runtime selected v0.1.0 as the baseline after replaying the proposal with its original producer using read-only GitHub requests.

## Merge danger

The workflow switch is reversible. Merging can open this repository's next release proposal under v2.
